webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Send signed events to other systems, and post to Slack or Microsoft Teams, when things happen in Orbit.
webhooks.intro: Each webhook receives a signed HTTPS request for the events you choose. Failed deliveries are retried automatically.
webhooks.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it instead.
webhooks.loadFailed: We could not load the webhooks
webhooks.loadFailedHint: Check your connection and try again.

forbidden.title: You do not have access to webhooks
forbidden.description: Managing webhooks needs the webhooks permission. Ask an administrator if you need it.

empty.title: No webhooks yet
empty.description: Add a webhook to tell another system the moment an asset is published, a task needs approval or a rendition is ready.

ping.error: Could not send the test ping

rotate.title: Rotate the signing secret?
rotate.body: A new secret is generated for “{{name}}” and shown once. The old secret stops working immediately, so update the receiver straight away or it will reject deliveries.

delete.title: Delete this webhook?
delete.body: “{{name}}” and its delivery history will be removed. Nothing more is sent to it.

events.allHint: Every event, including ones added in future.
events.derivedHint: Derived event: sent when a related event has a particular outcome, in addition to that event.
events.customHint: An event name, or a prefix ending in .* such as workflow.task.* . Press Enter to add.

form.name: Name
form.urlHint: Must be an http or https address that the Orbit server can reach. Private and local addresses are refused unless this installation allows them.
form.urlRequired: Enter the URL to send events to.
form.urlInvalid: Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://.
form.eventsUnavailable: The list of events could not be loaded. Close this panel and try again.
form.activeHint: Switch off to pause deliveries without deleting the webhook.
form.secretNote: A signing secret is generated when you create the webhook and shown once.

secret.intro: Use this secret in the receiver of “{{name}}” to check that each request really came from Orbit.
secret.warning: This is the only time the secret is shown. Copy it now and keep it somewhere safe. If you lose it, rotate the secret to get a new one.
secret.label: Signing secret

verify.title: How to verify signatures
verify.intro: Every delivery is a POST with a JSON body and these headers:
verify.event: The event name, such as asset.published.
verify.delivery: A unique id for this delivery (a retry keeps it, a replay gets a new one).
verify.timestamp: Unix time in seconds when the request was signed.
verify.rules: Compute the HMAC-SHA256 of the timestamp, a dot and the raw request body, using the secret exactly as shown (whsec_…) as the key. Compare it to the signature in constant time, and reject requests whose timestamp is more than 5 minutes old. The header may carry several v1= values; any match is valid.

deliveries.caption: Webhook deliveries, newest first
deliveries.loadFailed: We could not load the deliveries
deliveries.emptyHint: Deliveries appear here as soon as an event matches a webhook, or when you send a test ping.
deliveries.noMatchHint: Try a wider date range or clear the filters.

detail.title: Delivery
detail.loadFailed: We could not load this delivery.
detail.noResponse: The receiver returned no body, or no attempt has completed yet.
detail.retryNote: Failed attempts are retried automatically, up to {{max}} attempts in all, waiting longer each time. A replay sends the same event again as a new delivery, signed with the current secret.

replay.title: Replay this delivery?
replay.body: The {{event}} event will be sent to “{{name}}” again as a new delivery, with the same payload and signed with the current secret.

replayDone.retrying: Replay sent, receiver did not accept it yet

channels.intro: Post a short message to Slack or Microsoft Teams when these events happen. Channels are shared by everyone in the organisation.
channels.urlHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
channels.urlEditHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again (currently {{hint}}). Leave empty to keep it.
channels.urlStored: The full URL is stored encrypted and is not shown
channels.howSlack: In Slack, create an app, turn on Incoming Webhooks, add it to a channel and copy the URL it gives you.
channels.howTeams: In Teams, open the channel’s Workflows, choose “Post to a channel when a webhook request is received” and copy the URL.
channels.activeHint: Switch off to stop posting without deleting the channel.

forbidden.description: Managing chat channels needs the notifications permission. Ask an administrator if you need it.
